            add = 90

    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:nobles } }

        name = oe_mil_dec_byz_drill.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -150
            set_variable = { name = oe_mil_dec_byz_cd value = 1 years = 10 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_mil_drill_readiness years = 8 mode = replace }

                limit = { oe_mil_age_5_plus = yes NOT = { oe_mil_byz_firearm_reformed = yes } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_mil_byz_reformed value = 1 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_byz_reformed value = 1 }
                if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mil_firepower_gap } remove_country_modifier = oe_mil_firepower_gap }
            }
        }
    }
}
